paragraphs: R' Elino bar Tavri; Shemot Rabbah 44:8. In Megillah, chapter 4, halakhah 12, Bar Tavri asked Rabbi Yitzchak a question.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Torat Emet Shemot Rabbah 44:8 paragraph names Rabbi Aloni ben Tavri in Rabbi Yitzchak’s name, whereas Hyman supplies Elino bar Tavri. That title is not transferred across the differing name form: Elino is rendered R'. The whole Guggenheimer Megillah 4:12 paragraph has Bar Tavri asking Rabbi Yitzchak. These are separate pointers, without a common-father or alias binding.
